title: The Funhouse After Dark
synopsis: The carnival has closed for the night and you're still inside the funhouse. Mister Giggles, the mischievous robot clown, has locked every door. Solve his games before the carnival lights go out!
artStyle: bright retro carnival at night, glowing bulbs, candy stripes, playful cartoon style
intro: Honk honk! Welcome, welcome, to Mister Giggles' Funhouse! The carnival is closed, the gates are locked, and I'm the only one with the keys. Want to go home? Then play my games! Work together, share what you find, and escape before the big lights go out in forty minutes. Ha-ha-HONK!
escapedText: The big gate swings open and the carnival lights twinkle goodnight. Mister Giggles waves a white glove: 'Fine, fine, you win! Come back tomorrow. I'll make it harder!' You're out!
failedText: The big lights go out with a POP and the carousel music winds down. Mister Giggles giggles in the dark: 'Looks like you're staying for the night shift!' Try again!

gameMaster.name: Mister Giggles
gameMaster.persona: A mischievous robot clown who honks, giggles and loves a good trick. Cheeky and silly, never scary: he teases the group when they're stuck and cheers (a little grumpily) when they win his games.

stages.title: The Hall of Mirrors
stages.description: A thousand of you stare back from the wobbly mirrors. Somewhere in here is the way out, and something is written backwards on the glass.

stages.title: The Game Booths
stages.description: Past the mirrors, the midway game booths glow. The duck pond is still bubbling, and the strongman bell stands in the corner with a lock on its mallet.

stages.title: The Big Top Gate
stages.description: The exit gate is right there, but a sleepy clown guard is snoring in front of it, and the ticket machine is blinking.

puzzles.title: The Backwards Riddle
puzzles.prompt: Written backwards on the biggest mirror: '?ti esu nac uoy erofeb nekorb eb ot sah tahW'
hints: Read it from right to left: 'What has to be broken before you can use it?'
You crack it for breakfast.
puzzles.solvedText: The mirror slides aside with a giggle. On a hook behind it: a little silver key.

variants.prompt: Written backwards on the biggest mirror: '?palc t'nac tub sdnah sah tahW'
hints: Read it from right to left: 'What has hands but can't clap?'
It tells the time.

variants.prompt: Written backwards on the biggest mirror: '?nwod semoc reven tub pu seog tahW'
hints: Read it from right to left: 'What goes up but never comes down?'
It gets bigger on every birthday.

puzzles.title: The Little Door
puzzles.prompt: Behind the mirrors, a door just big enough to crawl through. It has a tiny silver lock.
hints: You found a key that's just the right size.
Use the silver key on the little door.
puzzles.solvedText: Click! You crawl through the little door and pop out by the game booths.

puzzles.title: The Duck Pond Prize Box
puzzles.prompt: The prize box has a 3-digit lock. The sign says: '{order}!' Each of you fished out one rubber duck.
hints: Each phone has one duck. Say your duck's color and number out loud.
Put them in the sign's order: {order}.
puzzles.solvedText: Quack! The prize box pops open. Inside: one shiny golden prize ticket.

generator.pieceTemplate: You fished out a {color} duck. Under it is the number {digit}.

puzzles.title: The Strongman Mallet
puzzles.prompt: The giant mallet is chained to the bell with a word lock. Carved on the handle: 'I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old.'
hints: It gets shorter every time it's used.
You light it on a birthday cake.
puzzles.solvedText: The chain falls away. The mallet is huge, but together you can lift it.

variants.prompt: The giant mallet is chained to the bell with a word lock. Carved on the handle: 'What has a neck but no head?'
hints: You drink from it.
Juice or water can come in one.

variants.prompt: The giant mallet is chained to the bell with a word lock. Carved on the handle: 'What has lots of teeth but can't bite?'
hints: You use it on your hair.
It keeps your hair neat and tidy.

puzzles.title: The Strongman Bell
puzzles.prompt: Ring the strongman bell loud enough to wake up the snoring clown guard!
hints: Bells need something to hit them.
Use the mallet on the bell.
puzzles.solvedText: DING! The guard jumps up, yawns, and waddles off, dropping a big brass key.

puzzles.title: The Ticket Machine
puzzles.prompt: The gate's ticket machine blinks: 'One golden prize ticket to leave, please!'
hints: You won something shiny at the duck pond.
Use the golden prize ticket.
puzzles.solvedText: The machine swallows the ticket and plays a happy tune. One lock on the gate clicks open.

puzzles.title: The Big Gate
puzzles.prompt: The last lock needs the brass key AND a password. Mister Giggles' voice crackles: 'Tell me the three carousel animals, first to last!'
hints: Three phones each remember one carousel animal.
Say them in order, first to last, like: animal animal animal.
puzzles.solvedText: The brass key turns and the password lights up the gate: {answer}!
